items.title: Fox (FOXA) Closes Its Roku Deal And Gives Anthony Wood A Digital Role
items.summary: Fox (NasdaqGS: FOXA) has completed its acquisition of streaming platform Roku, bringing the service fully under Fox Corporation. Roku founder Anthony Wood has been appointed to the Fox board and named Co-Chair of the new FOX Digital Platforms division. Fox has created the FOX Digital Platforms unit to house its expanded streaming and digital assets following the Roku transaction.
